name: Chevron Alignment
spec: yellow vertical rectangle with one large black chevron arrow pointing right
meaning: The road bends sharply in the direction the chevron points.

snippets.back: Odd paint warns too: diagonal stripes cage fixed blocks, solid lines funnel past hazards, twin solid white bars any lane swap, curbs and fire lanes may ban parking by local order, and a sharrow’s chevrons over a bike mark a shared lane to watch for riders.
A sharrow combines a bicycle picture with a double chevron and marks a narrow lane shared by bicycles and motor vehicles.
Chevron signs back up curve signs wherever a direction change needs extra emphasis.
A sharrow combines a bicycle image with two chevrons and recommends a bicycle's position within a shared lane.
The illustrated black chevron on yellow warns of a sharp curve.
A large arrow placed on the outside of a turn and chevron signs at curves both stress the need to slow down for a sharp change of direction.
A Curve sign warns of a curve ahead, a Sharp Turn sign of a sharp turn ahead, and a Chevron sign marks a sharp curve or change of direction right at the sign.
Chevron signs along sharp curves help show the direction of the bend, especially at night or in poor visibility.
